listing.name: NBA JAM: On Fire Edition (OpenJam)
listing.summary: Upstream route: UpstreamWindowsrelease includes game/runtime plus NBAJAMModManager.exe. Unzip beside own signedXBLAcontainer; manager extracts game, sets folders, converts optionalPS3modpackages and launches. This is runtime+data/modsetup, not demonstrated player compilation. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream says it runs/plays and converts PS3 mods. Complete-game, multiplayer and all-mod compatibility unverified here. Windows win64 release only, setup generates game code. Distinct from NBA Jam arcade and other editions; upstream plays claim without full-game validation here. Upstream platforms: Windows game/mod manager documented; win64 asset observed. Other native OS routes Unknown despite framework portability. Original data: Xbox360 XBLA NBA JAM OnFireEdition own signed console package. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
